fact.en: Assuming the Sangam period was purely Vedic; it was actually a blend of tribal folk religion and emerging Brahmanism.
fact.hi: Assuming the Sangam period was purely Vedic; it was actually a blend of tribal folk religion and emerging Brahmanism.

fact.en: Confusing 'Hero Stone' (Viragal) worship with Buddhist Stupa worship; Hero stones are indigenous Tamil traditions.
fact.hi: Confusing 'Hero Stone' (Viragal) worship with Buddhist Stupa worship; Hero stones are indigenous Tamil traditions.

fact.en: Thinking temples existed in the 'stone-structure' sense; early places of worship were 'Manrams' or open-air sacred groves.
